status: Physical ASIC proposal with implemented local SRAM scheduler and directed pin-level tests; full beam/decoder/CDC/PLL and STA remain outside.

authority.deviation_scope: Fixed-rate physical sampling and a proposed faster local-memory domain, not a replacement public register specification.

clocks.implementation: Y2 is the 13.5-MHz reference. U2 forwards a constant 13.5-MHz VIDEO_PCLK and contains a proposed fixed x4 PLL for the local-memory datapath. No register field changes either physical clock.
remaining_gates: ASIC PLL selection, jitter, lock/reset and clock-tree implementation
Generated-clock STA and source-synchronous DAC setup/hold
Update ASIC/SRAM switching-power, rail-current and thermal budgets for the 54-MHz local domain.

sampling.raw_register_words: Preserved verbatim in programmed/display registerfiles; fields feed the rational datapath without clamping.
sampling.configuration_reduction: 2*LC = Q0*N + R0; 0 <= R0 < N. Configuration producer owns this division.
sampling.horizontal_numerator: Xn=(global_half_line_index&1)*N+P; use the unwrapped physical half-line parity for source coordinates too.
sampling.logical_pixel_index: K=quotient(Xn,2*D*StepX), when the existing StepX output gate is nonzero.
sampling.sampled_signal_coordinate: StepX*K; apply the existing window/source equations at this coordinate.
sampling.sample_time: One output sample every 1/13.5MHz, regardless of how many logical source pixels or half-lines were crossed.
sampling.overspeed_behavior: Logical pixels not selected at a DAC sampling instant are not fetched/emitted. Physical levels and sync edges are sampled at the fixed clock; sub-sample pulses can alias away. This is explicit decimation/time quantization, not an invalid-mode rejection or a hidden clamp.
sampling.multiple_events: Physical sampled phase may cross several half-lines or fields; reduce these counts arithmetically for the sampled display-coordinate bookkeeping. The periodic-crossing test demonstrates this arithmetic only; it does not implement pending CSR events, FIELD ordering, the display latch or reset/MMIO semantics. No GHz event loop or queued analog pulses.
sampling.horizontal_phase: Carry global physical half-line parity across field wraps, including odd625-half-line interlaced fields. Only an explicitly coherent displayed-bank restart may establish a new physical phase origin. See design/analog_video_profile.json; CPU-live beam/event semantics remain unchanged.
sampling.pipeline: Horizontal/source quotients may be pipelined; carry the same beam/configuration tag through RGB and sync front-end. Eight DAC samples is only the memory-model request-to-output budget. Pin-to-connector alignment additionally includes falling-edge launch, rising-edge capture, the ADV7125 one-clock pipeline, and the separate CSYNC analog path. Match complete path delays rather than blindly adding one CSYNC sample; see design/analog_video_profile.json. Epoch/CDC integration and loaded-connector measurement remain open.
sampling.live_and_displayed_timing: Keep the existing CPU-visible live beam/event/CSR owner logically in the SYS domain, including its event deadlines, FIELD updates and display-latch boundary. Do not quantize that owner to DAC ticks. The physical sampler consumes coherent displayed state and a correctly timestamped FIELD/configuration epoch. This numerical model exercises one fixed bank only; timestamp transfer, epoch ordering and CDC still require RTL integration tests.
sampling.zero_fields: Existing run-control/zero timing and StepX=0 gates remain datapath gates, not new fallback modes.

widths.note: The recurrent phase path has one add and one conditional subtract, not an eight-stage feedback divider. Since R0 <= 254, P+R0 <= Nmax-1+254 fits 22 bits. The configuration producer can also reduce both possible crossed-half-line counts Q0 and Q0+1 modulo total-half-lines, leaving one add/conditional subtract for the field-index recurrence. Source divisions are feed-forward pipelined arithmetic. These widths prove finite representation, not timing closure.

memory.read_non_sram_budget_ns: 1000/54 - 10 = 8.518518... for ASIC tCO + PCB outward/return delay + setup + jitter/skew
memory.format_note: CT32/CT24 use one aligned external 32-bit word; GPU24 can use two distinct words and is defined on circuit 1 only. Selector 18 on circuit 2 supplies the already-specified zero sample, not a newly added black fallback. See the independent TS/C++ owner probe.
memory.scheduler_slots: 0..47 scanout-only reads with work-conserving circuit1,circuit1,circuit2 preference. 48 guard. 49..62 renderer reads(1 slot) or writes(2 slots), direction guards consume this same budget; no write starts after61. 63 guard.
memory.write_note: Real async_sram RTL supplies two-slot writes and full direction guards. Generated-clock/pad/PCB STA and SRAM pin timing qualification remain required.
memory.underrun_contract: An empty per-circuit decoded FIFO does not clock that circuit's pixel latch or advance its FIFO read pointer. Its raw RGBA latch retains the previous sample while beam/sync continue; later valid data is consumed in FIFO order, potentially shifted. No automatic black substitution, timing slowdown, hidden recovery or public CSR addition. Queue/configuration epoch transitions remain an RTL integration obligation.
memory.limits: The mathematical sample model assumes at most three uncached words per physical sample and two decode slots. Actual scheduler RTL tests cover addressed 2+1 word jobs every4 clocks, all64 calendar phases, renderer writes and real SRAM models: maximum raw delivery22clocks, not a full decoded/DAC/CDC proof. Arbitrarily full raw queues can take258/514clocks to deposit circuit1/2 results; capacity is not a per-job8sample deadline.
memory.decoded_fifo_scope: 128 decoded entries per circuit are a separate output-pipeline proposal, not the implemented raw-word rings. No decoded storage or beam/CDC implementation is inferred from those rings.

analog.launch_capture_target: Launch RGB/control at the falling 13.5-MHz edge; DAC captures on rising edge. Budget source tCO, U40 and PCB clock/data skew against DAC setup/hold; not yet STA-qualified.
analog.no_TV_claim: Reset 628 half-lines gives 49.761146Hz, not a claimed PAL-compliant profile. The digital HSINT/VSINT landmarks do not define the full SCART composite-sync/equalization waveform. Standard 625/525-line waveform selection, half-line phase, analog filters/levels and actual monitor qualification remain open.

references.use: Production separation of timing generator, memory reader/decoded stream, clock-domain crossing, underflow signal and fixed-rate PHY. This proposal does not copy its host validation or zeroing behavior.
RevD Tables3/4 and ordering guide: 50-MHz grade, clock8ns high/low, setup/hold, ST-48; no unbounded variable-clock claim.
RevF -10BLL SRAM timing: read10ns; generated-clock and PCB remainder is an implementation gate.
Clock-buffer electrical delay/loading owner; output timing remains unqualified.
